services.name: Custom Blouse Stitching
services.short_description: Designer & traditional blouses with precision tailoring, custom necklines & padding options.
services.description: Expertly stitched blouses tailored to your unique measurements. Choose from boat neck, sweetheart, deep back, collar neck, princess cut, or katori cut styles. High-quality lining, reinforced seams, and perfect armhole fitting guaranteed.

services.name: Designer Dress Stitching
services.short_description: Custom tailored western, indo-western, A-line, fit-and-flare, and evening gowns.
services.description: Bespoke dresses created from your chosen fabric. Includes flared gowns, midi dresses, wrap dresses, and party wear with premium finishing, concealed zippers, and structured bodices.

services.name: Kurti & Tunic Stitching
services.short_description: Straight-cut, Anarkali, high-low, and daily wear kurtis with delicate stitching.
services.description: Comfortable and stylish kurtis designed for daily wear, office, and festivities. Custom options include side slits, pocket additions, button plackets, and sleeve variations.

services.name: Saree Blouse Alterations
services.short_description: Tightening, loosening, cup adjustments, sleeve modifications, and hook replacements.
services.description: Quick turnaround alterations to make your existing saree blouses fit like a glove. Seamless margin adjustments without compromising fabric integrity.

services.name: Trouser & Pant Stitching
services.short_description: Tailored cigarette pants, palazzo, straight trousers, and formal pants.
services.description: Custom fit bottoms with options for elasticated backbands, side zippers, functional deep pockets, and sleek ankle slits.

services.name: Flared & Pleated Skirt Stitching
services.short_description: Lehenga skirts, circular skirts, box pleat skirts, and tiered ethnic skirts.
services.description: Voluminous and structured skirts crafted with can-can lining, waist belt finishing, drawstring latkans, and side zipper closures.

services.name: Suit & Salwar Kameez Stitching
services.short_description: Complete 2-piece or 3-piece suit sets with custom neck designs and bottom styles.
services.description: Tailored salwar kameez, Punjabi suits, palazzo suits, and churidar sets with lining options, piping accents, and matching dupatta edging.

services.name: Garment Alteration & Repair
services.short_description: Hemming, waist resizing, zip replacements, tapering, and fitting adjustments.
services.description: Precision alteration services for all types of garments. Fast, neat, and reliable adjustments to breathe new life into your wardrobe.
